Allergen Information

All allergens are listed for each dish in the details section. However, our food is prepared in a kitchen where the 14 major allergens recognised under UK law are handled, so cross-contamination cannot be excluded. If you have a serious allergy or intolerance, please tell us before ordering so we can advise you on the safest options. For the full list of allergens and nutrition info, see our Allergens & Nutrition page.
